That night the beam swept farther than ever, and he wrote in the log: message received; light kept burning.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一块被海水浸过的玻璃，路灯还亮着，街道却已经空得能听见风穿过广告牌的声音。早点铺刚升起第一缕白汽，清洁车慢慢碾过湿漉漉的路面。高楼里的窗子零星亮着，像失眠的人睁开眼。有人在便利店门口喝完最后一口热饮，有人拖着行李赶向车站。天边还没有颜色，但城市已经悄悄醒来，在沉默中整理好新一天的秩序。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves a small part of itself and then asks a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- It needs a stopping rule, like 'when the box is empty, stop,' or it will keep going forever.\n- Think of Russian dolls: to count all dolls, count one, then use the same trick on the smaller dolls inside."}
